supersedes: v2 (reviewed the ef957a9 lineage before e94fb456 was fetched) and v1 (blocked)
purpose: Reviewer-owned assignment record for Wave-C shard A. Four families were reviewed end to end against real official source bytes and page-by-page visual inspection. The scope caveats below are recorded because they change what this review does and does not establish; they were not worked around.

assignmentBasis.explanation: The assignment specifies deriving a 16-family denominator at base e94fb456 and taking slice [0:4]. That derivation remains impossible in this repository (see scopeCaveats). The four families below were instead named explicitly by the reviewer source pack manifest (rcap-wave-c-review-source-pack/v1, shard a, familyCount 4). This review therefore verifies those four families on their own evidence; it does not establish that they are the correct slice of a 16-family denominator.

corpus.note: Four-PDF shard pack, as the instruction directs. The 499-file corpus was not required. Every source byte these four families need is present and hash-verified; private/ remains gitignored and uncommitted.

scopeCaveats.detail: The follow-up instruction names the four families explicitly and directs that the unrelated 499-file corpus not be required. The four were taken from that instruction and the pack manifest, which agree exactly. No 16-family denominator was derived.

All-page rasters were produced by the reviewer with pypdfium2 at scale=2.0 from the e94fb456 bytes and their SHA-256 pinned per family in final-verdicts.json, so the visual inspection is reproducible.
At e94fb456 both fieldMapSha256 and classificationSha256 hash the file bytes directly. The bindings-array referent that applied on the older lineage no longer does. Both recompute exactly here.

historicalObjections.detail: Historical objections for all four families were read from correction-queue.json, correction-packets.json, batch-1-group-3.review.json and batch-1-cross-family-findings.json at e94fb456, and each was evaluated against the current bytes rather than trusted from its prior flag. Results per objection are recorded in final-verdicts.json.

correctedCourse.whatWentWrong: The first two passes concluded e94fb456 did not exist. It did; this clone had only origin/main and the reviewer branch until the remotes were fetched. The ef957a9 lineage carries the pre-correction frozen artifacts, so the v2 verdicts described the wrong bytes.
correctedCourse.howCorrected: Fetched all remotes, extracted the four family trees at e94fb456 read-only, and redid every step against those bytes: source hashes, map/classification/sidecar/artifact/contact-sheet hashes, all-page rasters, geometric containment, structural sanitation, and every historical objection.
correctedCourse.priorRecordDisposition: verdicts.json is retained, marked authoritative:false with supersededBy set. No historical verdict belonging to another lane was touched.
